chicama.interpretation: The official ANA course table independently supports the named Chicama tributary identities and their membership in UH 13772. It does not by itself prove the ZEE polygon identity, channel geometry, confluence or outlet.

chao.interpretation: ANA 2018 course classification and ANA 2023 Chorobal/Tutumo/Tucumaca documentary topology use different naming representations. No automatic equivalence between Chorobal and Río Chao/Huamansaña/Tutumo is allowed until reproducible line topology and outlet QA resolve the crosswalk.

scientific_boundary: Official course codes constrain identity and parent UH membership, but do not create geometry, subcatchments, event footprints, confluences, outlets, hydraulic capacity or operational thresholds.
next_safe_action: Freeze exact ZEE polygons and 50k/100k line candidates; then perform code-to-geometry, continuity, confluence and outlet adjudication with the 2018 course table and 2023 documentary relationships as independent constraints.
